GUIDE: Dev Tools --> Application Tab

Clearing cookies is a common problem-solving technique when the browser is awry. Use CTRL + SHIFT + DEL shortcut to clear browser history and cache, generally for the last hour.

On the frontside, the issue may resolve. Behind the scenes, the browser is clearing temporarily stored files, references, and objects from the application tab in the dev tools.

Cleared Browsing Data

  1. Browsing history
  2. Download history
  3. Cache items
  4. Local storage
  5. Cookies
  6. ...more

Service workers will not delete without manually uninstalling them, or the site that installed it has done so.

Sources:

  • How To Uninstall, Unregister Or Remove A Service Worker
  • What you should know before making a service worker

Examples are using Edge browser. Chrome and Firefox use the same keyboard shortcut and application tab.
